summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms, but did not run tests, flake8, or black, per instructions; compliance was checked by reading only. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gained Lambda (appended at end; asserts callable with "func must be callable"; no base init call). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py: typing import now "Callable, Optional"; Lambda import added; Lambdad class added between ConcatItemsd and the alias block (two blank lines each side); LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad appended after ConcatItemsD. docs/source/transforms.rst: Lambda entry before SplitChannel, Lambdad entry before Transform Adaptors. New tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py cover identity, slicing (spatial axes only), caller-mapping immutability, and unlisted-entry preservation. git diff shows only the typing line removed; nothing committed.
